utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Morning all. You can tell it's Monday, ring road was absolute carnage getting in. Right, let's get cracking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, same here. Took me ages off the bypass.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: At least you got a coffee first. Canteen machine's still knackered, so that's me in a mood already.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Ha, proper disaster that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Worst outage on site, that. Right, quick round then. Sarah, anything from night shift?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nothing major. Handover was pretty clean. No trips, no production losses overnight, just the usual alarms chattering and clearing.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Good. Marcus?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, CHP side was steady. And just for info, I signed off the inspection on the water ring on Tuesday, so that's closed out already, nothing for today on that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Nice one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Tomasz?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Couple of bits. I tested the desiccant unit yesterday and it's all fine now, so that's done, doesn't need carrying over. Other than that, just housekeeping jobs.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Good stuff. Priya?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Electrically we're alright. Only blocker is we're still waiting on parts for the pump in the pit, nothing we can do until they arrive, so that one's stuck where it is.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, parked till stores can actually magic bits out of nowhere.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Cheers for that, Reidy.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: You walked into that one, mate. Jamie, while you're there?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, so I already swapped the filter on the HV switchboard yesterday, that's finished, not a task for today. I also saw the pressure on the FLTs dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own, so just an observation really.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Any repeat on the FLTs or literally just the one wobble?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Just the one I saw. It settled straight after.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fine, just keep an eye on it. Grace, anything HSE-wise?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Nothing new, just permits to tidy and a couple of RAMS queries. The big one is making sure the isolations are signed properly before anyone gets near GT2.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah. On that, I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve this morning.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Good, that needs your name on it anyway.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That'll help, because once that's done we can actually get in without loads of faff.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And while we're on GT2, I'll take vibration readings on the number two bearing this morning as well, just so we've got fresh numbers before anything else moves.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Makes sense.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, and I'll grease and check the bearings on the GT2 Number 2 Bearing on Friday. Needs doing this week, so I'll take that one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers, Priya, that's in.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: You wanting me anywhere near GT2 for that or are you covered?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Should be alright once Reidy's done the sign-off. If I need a hand lifting covers I'll shout.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right. Next one, the pressure drop on the turbine two water valve. Grace, can you investigate the pressure drop on the turbine two water valve tomorrow? It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Tomorrow's no good for me, I've got the contractor audit first thing and then COSHH review most of the day. I can look at paperwork but I can't properly investigate it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Mm. Fair.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I can pick that up if needed.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah? Stores Jamie, can you investigate the pressure drop on the turbine two water valve tomorrow? It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, alright, I'll investigate the pressure drop on the turbine two water valve tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'll send you the notes I've got so you're not starting cold.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Perfect.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Also, stores Jamie, I need you to update the risk assessment for work on the big board by Thursday. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, okay, I'll update the risk assessment for work on the big board by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Make sure you use the latest permit wording, not the old template.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, yeah, I've got the newer one saved.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And another one for you, stores Jamie: run a function test on the line 3 chiller. Fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Okay, I'll run a function test on the line 3 chiller.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Can that be before lunch ideally? Ops were moaning about temperatures Friday.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I'll try, depends what I get dragged into first, but I'll get it done.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right. Separate one, I'll swap the filter on the power pack on one by the 28th, it's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: By the 28th and urgent is a very Reidy combo.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Look, it's urgent in planning terms, not coffee-machine urgent.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Nothing's coffee-machine urgent.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Can we print that on the board?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Behave. Jamie, anything else from your side?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, one actually. I'll do the pre-use checks on the FLTs today at 2pm, that's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, because days are already asking when they can get them back.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, I'll get on with that first before I disappear into paperwork.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Nice one.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: On the FLTs, if the pressure dip comes back, do you want me to log it through operations or straight to Jamie?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Log it through ops and copy Jamie in. But just to be clear, that's only if it reappears, we're not opening a fresh job off one blip.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, exactly, I just noticed it, wasn't suggesting a whole saga.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Wish the pump in the pit was that easy. Still nothing till parts land.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Have we got any ETA at all on those?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Supplier said midweek last I checked, but until it's on the van it's just words, isn't it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fine. So pump in the pit remains blocked, no action today. Anything else live?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Just remind whoever's in the big board area that the access route's still a bit tight with the stored cable drums.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll tell the shift, but that's just awareness, not another job.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I've got routine rounds and water chemistry, nothing worth boring everyone with.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Same. I've got some PM sheets to clear but nothing needing agreement here.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Alright, I'll read back the actual actions so we don't all invent different meetings. Reidy's doing the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve this morning, and taking vibration readings on the number two bearing this morning.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Priya's going to grease and check the bearings on the GT2 Number 2 Bearing on Friday, needs doing this week.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Stores Jamie is going to investigate the pressure drop on the turbine two water valve tomorrow, it's urgent; update the risk assessment for work on the big board by Thursday, normal priority; and run a function test on the line 3 chiller, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I'm also swapping the filter on the power pack on one by the 28th, it's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And Jamie's doing the pre-use checks on the FLTs today at 2pm, that's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, all good from me.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: All fine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Sounds right.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Amazingly organised for a Monday.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Don't ruin it. Right, crack on, cheers everyone.
